candidats.description: Spire stop on the doorway leading from the mural staircase into the room on the first floor in the Prior's Tower at Kells Priory. Only the doorways on the 1st floor and 2nd floor (and the entrance door) have chamfer stops, all of this shape. Presumably, the priors only brought visitors up to the 2nd floor, so they did not need fancy architecture further up.

candidats.description: Busáras is the central bus station and hub for intercity and regional bus services operated by Bus Éireann in Dublin, Ireland. "Central Bus Station" is sometimes used as the English name of the station. Busáras is also a stop on the Red Line of the Luas system, just before the terminus at Dublin Connolly railway station. Busáras was designed by Michael Scott and his team of young architects and designers between 1945 and 1953. It was built against a background of public opposition which centred on the external appearance, function and excessive cost - over £1,000,000 before completion in 1953.
categories: Republic of Ireland photographs taken on 2008-10-05
